g.text: Goggle eye construction (Dot shown, head width W = 0.92 HH)
inner edges overlap by 0-2% W, so the eyes always touch
pupil Ø = 0.11 × sclera Ø, solid ink, no iris, no highlight
dashed ring = max pupil travel (0.30 r); both pupils move together
dazed or wonky: pupils may diverge by up to 4% of sclera Ø
outline 3.5 px, wobble 0.9 px (slightly wonkier than body)
Lids: a skin-coloured shape clipped to the sclera, with its lower edge inked as a 2.75 px interior line. The % is how much of the sclera height is covered.
Gloam has no brows, so his lids do all the acting. Dot and Teo have brows (2.75 px interior strokes) 0.08 HH above the sclera top, which move ±12° in rotation and up to 0.04 HH in y.
